name: Froonty
description:
A compact Dynamic-Island-style entry point at the top center of the screen that reuses GNOME Shell's own clock, calendar and notification facilities. The Notifications tab shows GNOME's own notifications; Froonty keeps no copy.

Clipboard access: with the Clipboard tab turned on in its settings (it is off by default), Froonty reads the clipboard on every copy and keeps a history of copied text, images and file locations on this computer only, so an entry can be copied again with a click. Passwords are never saved: copies marked secret by password managers, copies made in password managers and authenticators, and copied text that looks like a password are only listed hidden, in memory, for a few minutes (adjustable, or not at all). Nothing is sent anywhere, and there is no shortcut for clipboard data.

Media: shows what music and video players report over MPRIS on the session bus and sends them play, pause, skip and seek. Two options use the internet and are off by default: cover art that a player gives as a web address is downloaded from that address, and lyrics are looked up on lrclib.net with the song's title, artist, album and length.

Claude Code integration (optional): Settings → Claude → Set up adds Froonty's hooks (and, separately, its status line) to Claude Code's settings file (~/.claude/settings.json); Claude Code then runs a GJS script shipped with Froonty that writes a small status file per session under $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/froonty, with no message text. Remove takes them out. Froonty never edits that file on its own.

Break tab (off by default): shows GNOME's own break reminders (Settings → Wellbeing) in the island, with exercise pictures from Workrave and a sit/stand tracker. It records only when you were at the computer or away, and daily totals, on this computer only. If you choose to be reminded by the island, Froonty turns off GNOME's Wellbeing notifications while the island is shown (this also hides GNOME's daily screen-time limit alerts) and turns them back on when the Break tab, the island or Froonty is turned off.
